attempts will be made to sabotage Public utility installations
on the second anniversary of the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese

and cables crossing the Soochow Creek, as it is at these
points that attempts will be made to cut off water and

"JULY 7" ANNIVERSARY : NO CEREMONY TO BE HELD
LOCALLY : LAY STRESS ON SPIRITUAL ASPECT BUT
NOT ON FORMAL APPEARANCES

To-morrow, July 7, being the second
anniversary of the war of resistance put up by China,
it is learned that the various local public bodies have
suggested that stress be laid on the spiritual aspect
and that formal observances be dispensed with. All
peasant, labour, merchant, student, youth and women
circles should contribute money and endeavour to work
in support of the war of resistance and the reconstruction
of the nation. As regards thoughts and belief, all
citizens throughout the country should observe whole-
heartedly the three principles of "supremacy," "concentration"
and "priority" as prescribed by the supreme leader and carry
them out thoroughly in order to struggle for the independence
and freedom of the nation. Apart from an observance of
silence at noon and going on a vegetable diet as a mark of
respect to the officers and men fallen at the front, no
other activities should be held for the time being.

“七七”纪念日：本地不举行仪式：强调精神层面而非形式外观

明日7月7日是中国抗战两周年纪念日，
据悉，本地各公共团体建议强调精神层面，
免去形式上的纪念活动。所有农、工、商、学、青年及妇女
界人士应捐款并努力开展工作，以支持抗战及
国家重建。在思想与信仰方面，全国公民应全心全意
遵守最高领袖规定的“至高”、“集中”
和“优先”三项原则，并彻底贯彻实行，以争取
国家的独立与自由。除正午默哀及素食以示对前线
阵亡将士的敬意外，暂时不举行其他活动。

We are in receipt of the following important
points for propaganda on the anniversary of the war of
resistance for national reconstruction promulgated by
the Central Publicity Department :-

(1) The Lukouchiao Incident which broke out
on July 7 in the 26th Year (1937) of the Chinese
Republic marked the final stage for the existence and
downfall and life and death of our nation. It was for
this reason that the National Government has resolutely
decided to start the present nation-wide war of
resistance in the hope of driving away the dwarf bandits
and to bring about the reconstruction of our nation.
Consequently, the National Government has fixed this
date as the anniversary of the war of resistance for
national reconstruction.

(2) Since the commencement of our war of
resistance following the outbreak of the Lukouchiao
Incident, two years have elapsed, in the course of which
the plans of the enemy to bring about an early conclusion
of the hostilities and our submission without resistance
were crushed by the military tactics of our nation-wide
and prolonged war of resistance. As a result, the
foundations for our victory have become stronger. There
are signs that the enemy will suffer defeat. Therefore,
so long as we remain firm in our determination in the
war of resistance and carry on the struggle to the
bitter end, we are sure to succeed in our work for
national reconstruction by means of the war of resistance.

(3) Owing to the failure of its military
operations against China, the enemy is using weak-minded
Wang Ching-wei as a puppet to mislead our brethren.
The second anniversary of the reconstruction of the
nation through the war of resistance is approaching;

我们收到国民党中央宣传部颁布的关于抗战建国周年纪念的重要宣传要点如下：-

(1) 中华民国二十六年（1937年）7月7日爆发的卢沟桥事变，标志着我国民族存亡、生死攸关的最后阶段。正因如此，国民政府坚决决定发动当前的全国性抗战，以期驱除倭寇，实现国家重建。因此，国民政府将此日定为抗战建国纪念日。

(2) 自卢沟桥事变爆发引发我国抗战以来，两年时间已经过去。在此期间，敌人企图早日结束敌对行动并使我们无条件投降的计划，被我国全面持久战的军事战术所粉碎。结果，我们胜利的基础更加牢固。敌人遭受失败的迹象已经显现。因此，只要我们坚定抗战决心，斗争到底，就一定能通过抗战成功实现国家重建工作。

(3) 由于对华军事行动失败，敌人正利用意志薄弱的汪精卫作为傀儡来误导我们的同胞。抗战建国两周年纪念日即将来临；

Chiang Kai-shek refuting the declaration of Prince Konoye

(5) Other important propaganda relating to

TRANSLATION OF FRENCH POLICE REPORT
No.1959 dated July 6, 1939.

JULY 7 ANNIVERSARY - LETTER FROM LOCAL TANGPU TO
CHINESE NEWSPAPERS.

On July 5, local Chinese newspapers are said to
have received an article for publication on July 7,
anniversary of the launching of the Sino-Japanese
hostilities. This article invites the population to
celebrate this anniversary in the following manner:-

1) At noon observe 3 minutes silence.
2) Refrain from eating meat.
3) Observe the following principles prescribed by
General CHIANG KAI-SHEK :-
a) The nation above all. The race above all.
b) Concentration of determination.
Concentration of strength.
c) The war of resistance before all.
Military operations before all.

The article also invites the population to refrain
from "all apparent activities," that is to say by
meetings, demonstrations, etc.. It seems to us,
however, that the publication of such an article in the
press is susceptible of provoking certain discontented
individuals. There is every reason, therefore, to
approach the responsible persons of the Chinese papers
requesting them to refrain from publishing the article in
question, translation of which is attached. According
to information received, this article emanates from
an agent of the local Tangpu.

------

（批：Dec B. / 282 / 47.）

七月七日纪念日 - 本地党部致中文报社的信件。

据悉，7月5日，本地中文报社收到一篇拟于7月7日（中日敌对行动爆发纪念日）刊登的文章。该文章呼吁民众以以下方式庆祝此纪念日：-

1) 正午默哀三分钟。
2) 禁食肉类。
3) 遵守蒋介石将军规定的以下原则：-
a) 国家至上。民族至上。
b) 意志集中。
力量集中。
c) 抗战第一。
军事第一。

该文章还呼吁民众避免“一切表面活动”，即
集会、示威等。然而，在我们看来，
在报刊上发表此类文章可能会引起某些不满分子
的骚动。因此，我们有充分理由接触中文报社的
负责人，请求他们不要刊登该文章，其译文附后。
根据收到的信息，这篇文章出自
本地党部的一名代理人之手。

------

（批：Dec B. / 282 / 47.）

JULY 7 ANNIVERSARY
NO CEREMONY WILL BE CELEBRATED IN SHANGHAI.
THE SPIRIT IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN THE FORM.

To-morrow, July 7, is the second anniversary of
the start of the Chinese War of Resistance. We learn
that local associations reckon that "The Spirit is of
more importance than the form." Also, peasant, workers'
commercial, students', women's circles, etc. must
dedicate their possessions and strength to contribute
them as they are able to the war of Resistance and
national reconstruction.

Insofar as thought and faith are concerned, the whole
nation must continue to observe the three principles of
our Supreme Chief:-

1) The nation above all. The race above all.

2) Concentration of determination.
Concentration of strength.

3) The War/Resistance before all.
Military operations before all.

in order to secure independence and liberty.

Citizens will observe, in their homes, 3 minutes
silence at midday in memory of the soldiers who have
fallen on the field of honour; they will refrain from
eating meat.

七月七日纪念日
上海不举行庆祝仪式。

明日7月7日是中国抗战开始两周年纪念日。我们获悉，本地社团认为“精神比形式更重要”。此外，农、工、商、学、妇女等界人士必须奉献其财产和力量，尽其所能贡献于抗战及国家重建。

在思想和信仰方面，全国必须继续遵守我们最高领袖的三项原则：-

1) 国家至上。民族至上。

2) 意志集中。
力量集中。

3) 抗战第一。
军事第一。

以确保独立与自由。

T R A D U C T I O N
-1-

Anniversaire du "7 Juillet".

Aucune cérémonie ne sera célébrée à Shanghai.

On attachera plus d'importance à l'esprit qu'à la forme.

______

Demain, 7 juillet, sera l'anniversaire du 8e anniversaire
du commencement de la guerre de résistance de la Chine. Nous ap-
prenons que les associations locales estiment qu'il faut attacher
plus d'importance à l'esprit qu'à la forme. Aussi, les milieux
agricoles, ouvriers, commerciaux, estudiantins, féminins, etc...
doivent consacrer leurs biens et leurs forces pour contribuer,
chacun à son poste, à la guerre de résistance et à la reconstruc-
tion nationale. En ce qui concerne la pensée et la foi, la nation
entière doit continuer à observer les trois principes de notre
Chef Suprême :

1°/ La nation au-dessus de tout. La race au-dessus de tout.
2°/ Concentration des volontés. Concentration des forces.
3°/ La guerre de résistance avant tout. Les opérations mili-
taires avant tout,

afin d'obtenir l'indépendance et la liberté de la nation.

Les citoyens observeront chez eux, à midi, 3 minutes de si-
lence à la mémoire des soldats tombés au champ d'honneur; ils
s'abstiendront de manger de la viande et de se livrer à toutes
divertissements apparentes./.

明日，7月7日，是中国抗战开始八周年纪念日。据悉，本地各团体认为应重精神而轻形式。因此，农、工、商、学、妇等各界应将各自财产与力量贡献于岗位，以助力抗战与国家重建。在思想与信仰方面，全国同胞应继续遵循我们最高领袖的三大原则：

1°/ 国家至上。民族至上。
2°/ 意志集中。力量集中。
3°/ 抗战第一。军事第一，

以求得国家的独立与自由。

Date July 7, 1939.

Subject Small paper National flags alleged distributed by
Shanghai Refugee Relief Association, 93 Canton Road.
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C Crawford D.S.

At 9.15 a.m., July 6, 1939, 2,000 small Chinese
national flags made of paper were seized by the French
Police at the Chinese Vocational Circle's School, 80
Route Voyron, French Concession, where they were on sale
at 2 cents each, apparently for use by the students on
July 7.

Hsia Hsiang Tse (謝向之), sub-director of the
school informed the French Police that the flags had
been brought to the school by Sze Yang Yong (施養勇)
director of the school, who he alleged had received them
from the Shanghai Refugees' Aid Committee, 93 Canton Road.

In consequence of the foregoing information,
D.S.I. Logan, D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken and C.D.C.355 Wang Lan
Sheng, called at the Shanghai Refugee Relief Association,
93 Canton Road, at 11.30 a.m., July 6, 1939, and
enquired as to the origin of the paper flags which are
alleged to have been manufactured in local refugee camps.
Wong Chien (王健) and Bang Zung Kung (龐任公),
two staff employees of the Association, who were
interviewed, denied that any refugee camps under the
direction of the association had manufactured such flags.
They nevertheless were warned that in view of the fact
that the Lukouchiao Anniversary falls on July 7, 1939,
the manufacture and sale of the flags would be
regarded as being in the nature of political activity
and would not be tolerated by the Municipal Police.
They promised to convey the instructions to the
members of the association for observation.

1939年7月6日上午9时15分，法租界巡捕在法租界魏尔恩路（Route Voyron）80号中华职业学校查获2,000面纸质小中国国旗，当时正以每面2分的价格出售，显然是供学生在7月7日使用。

该校副校长谢向之（Hsia Hsiang Tse）告知法租界巡捕，这些国旗是由该校校长施养勇（Sze Yang Yong）带到学校的，据称施是从广东路93号上海难民救济委员会收到的。

鉴于上述情况，副督察长洛根（Logan）、副督察长高延肯（Kao Yen Ken）及华探目355号王兰生（Wang Lan Sheng）于1939年7月6日上午11时30分前往广东路93号上海难民救济协会，查询据称在当地难民营制造的纸质国旗的来源。
该协会两名职员王健（Wong Chien）和庞任公（Bang Zung Kung）在接受询问时否认该协会下属的任何难民营制造过此类国旗。尽管如此，他们受到警告，鉴于1939年7月7日是卢沟桥事变周年纪念日，制造和销售此类国旗将被视为具有政治活动性质，工部局警务处不予容忍。他们承诺将指示传达给协会成员遵照执行。

Extract from daily Intelligence Report dated July 5, 1939.

July 7 Anniversary

It is somewhat difficult to confirm reports bearing on observance of this anniversary. Summarizing such information as has come to hand, it is possible that literature on the following points will be distributed:

(1) Anti-Wang Ching-wei : It is reported that a campaign scheduled to be launched on July 1 will continue for a week. So far there is nothing to confirm this.

(2) Pro-Wang Ching-wei : The recent visit to Shanghai of Wang Ching-wei and the existence in Shanghai of a clique allegedly working on his peace movement may result in advantage being taken of this anniversary to carry out a propaganda campaign.

(3) Pro-Chiang Kai-shek : Literature bearing on this anniversary may be distributed surreptitiously.

(4) Anti-British : Attempt to extend to the Settlement the sponsored movement in territory under Japanese control. Demonstrations are hardly possible owing to police arrangements for that day but dissemination of literature is not unlikely.

Reports that certain elements plan sabotage are without confirmation but inquiries are being continued in this connexion and any further information will be circulated in due course.

SERVICE SUR LES LIMITES NORD ET OUEST

En dehors des quinze points de passages désignés dans
la Note de Service n° 29, toutes les rues et tous les pas-
sages permettant d'entrer sur la Concession devront être
barrés avec des chevaux de frise et la circulation y sera
rigoureusement interdite. Les chevaux de frise seront dépo-
sés dans la soirée du 6. Les chefs de postes pourront deman-
der à la Direction de faire mettre à leur disposition le
nombre de camions et de coolies municipaux nécessaire. Seules
les maisons et cités qui n'ont aucune communication avec l'in-
térieur de la Concession pourront garder libre accès sur
la limite. En particulier, les maisons, magasins et passages
qui permettent de passer du Settlement sur la Concession
devront avoir leurs portes et fenêtres fermées, et seront
surveillés de près. La surveillance des secteurs Nord et
Ouest sera répartie de la façon suivante:

-Quai de France à Montauban exclus - Poste de l'Est
-Montauban à Montigny exclus - Poste Mallet
-Montigny à Paul Beau exclus - Poste Joffre
-Paul Beau à Roi Albert inclus - Poste Central
-Roi Albert exclus à Boissezon incl.- Poste Foch
-Boissezon exclus à Paul Siz - Poste Pétain

Le Chef de secteur de la zone de Zikawei prendra aussi
des dispositions pour renforcer la surveillance aux limites
et au besoin fermer le passage de Columbia Road.

- Les agents en service sur les limites Nord et Ouest
seront répartis suivant le tableau ci-joint --

CONSIGNES DES AGENTS DE SERVICE AUX RUES NON BARRÉES

Tous les véhicules et piétons se présentant aux rues
non barrées pour entrer sur la Concession, devront être
soigneusement fouillés. Pour faciliter le contrôle en ces
points de passage, les piquets de fouilles feront passer à
pied les occupants des J.I.S. publics ou privés, des auto-
bus, des tramways où il y aura lieu de fouiller. Les véhi-
cules seront donc visités à vide, et les voyageurs pourront
y reprendre place aussitôt après la fouille. Pour toutes ces
opérations, il y aurait lieu d'agir avec tact et mesure, en
particulier, d'éviter les incidents avec les étrangers qui
en principe ne doivent pas être soumis à la fouille. Les
femmes ne pourront être fouillées que par des fouilleuses
( les chefs de postes recruteront parmi les femmes des agents,
le nombre de fouilleuses nécessaire; en principe, 4 se re-
levant deux à deux à chaque rue ouverte. Une indemnité de
1 $ sera donnée à chaque fouilleuse ).

L'attention des piquets de fouilles se portera prin-
cipalement sur toutes les personnes ou voitures rentrant
sur la Concession. Les personnes ou véhicules sortant de la
Concession ne seront fouillés que lorsqu'ils paraîtront
suspects.

在未设路障街道执勤警员的指令

所有试图通过未设路障街道进入租界的车辆和行人，都必须经过仔细搜身检查。为了在这些通行点便于检查，搜身小队将要求公共或私人 jitneys（小型公共汽车）、公共汽车和有轨电车上的乘客下车步行接受检查，如有必要的话。因此，车辆将在空载状态下接受检查，乘客可在搜身结束后立即重新上车。在进行所有这些操作时，应采取谨慎和适度的态度，特别是避免与外国人发生冲突，原则上外国人不应接受搜身检查。女性只能由女搜查员进行搜身（各巡捕房主管将从女警员中招募所需数量的女搜查员；原则上，每条开放街道安排4人，两人一组轮流值班。每位女搜查员将获得1美元的津贴）。

搜身小队的注意力将主要集中在所有进入租界的人员或车辆上。离开租界的人员或车辆只有在显得可疑时才会被搜查。

<u>Instructional Memo</u>
<u>Confidential</u>

The approach of the Anniversary of the
Lukaochiao Incident on July 7, 1937 is susceptible
of causing incidents :-
(1) By agitation fomented by certain parties
accompanied by propaganda in the shape of
leaflets or posters;
(2) By concerted or isolated acts of terrorism;
(3) By labour troubles or agitation in university
circles;
(4) By incidents between local Japanese and Chinese.
------

It is extremely important that Headquarters
be exactly informed of the preparations that may be
made either by organizations or groups, or by isolated
individuals in order to prevent incidents coming
within the above mentioned categories.

<u>POLITICAL BRANCH</u>

Arrangements will be made immediately by the
Political Branch to :-
(a) Watch as far as possible activities of political
groups, organizations, labour unions and
associations;
(b) Watch the activities of refugee camps and
charitable organizations with patriotic
tendencies;
(c) Secure information on the movements of political
personalities;

<u>机密</u>

1937年7月7日卢沟桥事变纪念日的临近可能会引发事件：-
(1) 由某些党派煽动的 agitation（煽动活动），并伴有传单或海报形式的宣传；
(2) 协同或孤立的恐怖主义行为；
(3) 劳工纠纷或大学圈子里的煽动活动；
(4) 当地日本人与中国人之间的事件。
------

总部确切了解各组织、团体或个人为防止上述各类事件发生而可能做出的准备，这一点极其重要。

<u>政治处</u>

政治处将立即作出安排以：-
(a) 尽可能监视政治团体、组织、工会和协会的活动；
(b) 监视具有爱国倾向的难民收容所和慈善组织的活动；
(c) 获取政治人物动向的情报；

news agencies and newspapers;
(e) Prevent and formally forbid all attempts to
hold meetings or organize demonstrations;
(f) Maintain constant liaison with the S.M.P.

-------

visit printing shops and bookstores; observation will

and pamphlets will be accelerated; searches will be

CRIME BRANCH

boarding houses, tea shops, especially in the

(2) Proceed with systematic searches of areas in the
MALLET and JOFFRE districts, and the areas
adjoining Avenue Foch and Route de Zikawei.

The number of searches provided for above

(3) Watch the arrival of passengers from coastal ports
and proceed with the search of baggage.
(4) Increase watches over jetties and wharfs, especially
where arrivals by sampan are concerned.
(5) Form search parties that will patrol Avenue Haig,
Avenue Foch and Avenue Edward VII.

June 27, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

JAPANESE COMMUNITY TO OBSERVE THE SECOND ANNIVERSARY
OF CHINA INCIDENT

In accordance with instructions
from the Foreign Minister, the Japanese Residents Corporation
has decided to observe the second anniversary of the China
Incident on July 7. The officials of the Japanese Residents
Corporation together with military and Consular officers and
prominent Japanese residents held a meeting at the Japanese
Club at 5 p.m. June 26 to discuss means of observing the
anniversary and they adopted the following general plan:-
1. On July 7 a memorial service will be held for
officers and men fallen in battle and a prayer will be offered
for soldiers in action.
a) A silent prayer for the spirits of officers and
men killed in action will be offered at 11 a.m.(Shanghai time).
Every Japanese resident in Shanghai should offer the prayer
wherever he should be at the moment. A signal will be given
for this by means of radio broadcast and sirens of steamships
and men-of-war in harbour.
b) The prayer for officers and men on the battle
fields will be offered at the Shanghai Shrine following
the silent prayer for the dead.
2. A reading of the Imperial Rescript issued on the
first anniversary of the China incident and the Imperial
Edict issued for the encouragement of the national spirit
will also be held. This reading should be performed at
every school, public organization, firm, bank and factory
at a convenient time.
3. On July 7 every Japanese family should partake of
only one dish at meals.
4. The money thus saved should be contributed to the
Government. Such contributions will be received by the
Japanese Residents Corporation, Japanese banks, firms, cotton
mills or other public organizations. Members of the Japanese
Emergency Women's Association will be requested to collect
contributions on the streets on July 7 and 8 and the money
so collected will be used for the purpose of comforting
wounded soldiers on August 13.
5. Every-body is asked to contribute waste products
such as scrap iron, pieces of cloth, old newspapers and
magazines, empty bottles and empty tins to the nearest school.
6. Suitable persons from among government officials
and influential civilians will be requested to make speeches
through radio broadcasting stations on the progress of the
Holy war and the understanding of the Japanese nation.
7. Lectures will be delivered at various schools.
8. Lectures will be delivered and pictures screened
at the Tairiku Hall of the "Tairiku Shimpo".

日侨社区将纪念“中国事变”二周年

根据外务省的指示，日本居留民团决定于7月7日纪念“中国事变”二周年。日本居留民团官员会同军方和领事馆官员以及知名日侨，于6月26日下午5时在日本俱乐部举行会议，讨论纪念方式，并通过了以下总体计划：
1. 7月7日将举行阵亡将士追悼会，并为现役军人祈祷。
a) 上午11时（上海时间）将为阵亡将士英灵默哀。在上海的每一位日本居民，无论当时身在何处，都应进行祈祷。将通过无线电广播以及港口内轮船和军舰的汽笛发出信号。
b) 在为死者默哀后，将在上海神社为战场上的将士举行祈祷仪式。
2. 还将宣读“中国事变”一周年时发布的诏书以及为鼓舞国民精神而发布的敕语。这一宣读应在每所学校、公共组织、公司、银行和工厂于方便的时间进行。
3. 7月7日，每个日本家庭在用餐时应只吃一道菜。
4. 由此节省下来的钱款应捐献给政府。此类捐款将由日本居留民团、日本银行、公司、棉纺厂或其他公共组织接收。日本妇女紧急协会的成员将被要求在7月7日和8日在街头募集捐款，所募款项将用于8月13日慰问伤兵。
5. 要求每个人向最近的学校捐献废铁、碎布、旧报纸杂志、空瓶和空罐等废旧物品。
6. 将邀请政府官员和有影响力的平民中的合适人选，通过广播电台就圣战的进展和日本国民的理解发表演讲。
7. 将在各学校举行讲座。
8. 将在《大陆新报》的大陆厅举行讲座并放映图片。

Shanghai, June 27, 1939.

Instructional Memo
Confidential

The approach of the Anniversary of the
Lukoachi Incident on July 7, 1937 is susceptible
of causing incidents :-
(1) By agitation fomented by certain parties
accompanied by propaganda in the shape of
leaflets or posters;
(2) By concerted or isolated acts of terrorism;
(3) By labour troubles or agitation in university
circles;
(4) By incidents between local Japanese and Chinese.
------
It is extremely important that Headquarters
be exactly informed of the preparations that may be
made either by organizations or groups, or by isolated
individuals in order to provoke incidents coming
within the above mentioned categories.

POLITICAL BRANCH

Arrangements will be made immediately by the
Political Branch to :-
(a) Watch as far as possible activities of political
groups, organizations, labour unions and
associations;
(b) Watch the activities of refugee camps and
charitable organizations with patriotic
tendencies;
(c) Secure information on the movements of political
personalities;

上海，1939年6月27日。

指令备忘录
机密

1937年7月7日卢沟桥事变周年纪念日临近，可能引发事故：
(1) 由某些党派煽动的 agitation，伴随传单或海报形式的宣传；
(2) 协同或孤立的恐怖主义行为；
(3) 劳工纠纷或大学圈内的 agitation；
(4) 当地日侨与华人之间的事故。
------
总部确切了解组织、团体或个人为引发上述各类事故而可能做出的准备，这一点极其重要。

政治科

政治科将立即做出安排，以：
(a) 尽可能监视政治团体、组织、工会和协会的活动；
(b) 监视具有爱国倾向的难民营和慈善组织的活动；
(c) 获取政治人物动向的情报；

page_data.en:
- 2 -

(d) Exercise strict control over printing shops,
news agencies and newspapers;
(e) Prevent and formally forbid all attempts to
hold meetings or organize demonstrations;
(f) Maintain constant liaison with the S.M.P.
for the exchange of political information.

-------

As from June 30, the Political Branch will
visit printing shops and bookstores; observation will
be kept over those spots from which leaflets are more
frequently thrown (Great World; Boulevard de Montigny;
Rue du Consulat); the seizure of unauthorized newspapers
and pamphlets will be accelerated; searches will be
made in certain establishments which will be specially
designated.

CRIME BRANCH

As from June 30, the Crime Branch should :-
(1) Intensify searches of hotels, lodging houses,
boarding houses, tea shops, especially in the
MALLET District.
(2) Proceed with systematic searches of areas in the
MALLET and JOFFRE districts, and the areas
adjoining Avenue Foch and Route de Zikawei.

The number of searches provided for above
must be increased between June 30 and July 7.
(3) Watch the arrival of passengers from coastal ports
and proceed with the search of baggage.
(4) Increase watches over jetties and wharfs, especially
where arrivals by sampan are concerned.
(5) Form search parties that will patrol Avenue Haig,
Avenue Foch and Avenue Edward VII.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

(d) 对印刷所、通讯社和报纸实行严格管控；
(e) 预防并正式禁止一切举行集会或组织示威的企图；
(f) 与上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）保持经常联络，交换政治情报。

-------

自6月30日起，政治股将巡视印刷所和书店；将对频繁抛撒传单的地点（大世界；蒙梯尼路；领事馆路）进行监视；加快查扣未经授权的报纸和小册子；将对某些特别指定的场所进行搜查。

刑事股

自6月30日起，刑事股应：
(1) 加强对旅馆、出租房屋、寄宿公寓、茶楼的搜查，特别是在马勒（MALLET）区。
(2) 对马勒（MALLET）区和霞飞（JOFFRE）区的区域，以及福煦路和徐家汇路毗邻地区，进行系统性搜查。

上述规定的搜查次数必须在6月30日至7月7日期间增加。
(3) 监视来自沿海港口的乘客抵达情况，并对行李进行搜查。
(4) 加强对码头和栈桥的监视，特别是涉及舢板抵达之处。
(5) 组建搜查队，在海格路、福煦路和爱德华七世路巡逻。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

(6) Instruct detectives and policemen on observation
and protective duties to be more vigilant and
intensify their searches near residences being
afforded protection.

------

In a general way, officers carrying out these
instructions, will search for arms and ammunition,
trouble makers and suspicious persons. All suspects
arrested in this period will be held in detention;
they will be released on instructions to be issued
later.

The Crime Branch and the Political Branch
will make all preventive arrests they deem necessary.

The Crime Branch will carry out observation
over busy public spots and will also carry out a
number of operations that will form the subject of
private instructions.

Signed : FABRE

(6) 指示负责监视和保护任务的侦探及警员提高警觉，并加强对受保护住宅附近的搜查力度。

------

一般而言，执行这些指令的警官将搜查武器弹药、滋事分子和可疑人员。在此期间逮捕的所有嫌疑人都将被拘留；他们将根据随后发布的指令予以释放。

刑事股和政治股将进行其认为必要的一切预防性逮捕。

刑事股将对繁忙的公共场所进行监视，并将执行若干项行动，这些行动将作为单独指令的主题。

Shanghai, June 30, 1939.

NOTE FOR OFFICERS-IN-CHARGE OF STATIONS

JULY 1 ANNIVERSARY

July 1, 1939, being a day authorized by Consular
Ordinance for the display of flags, the officer-in-charge
will not interfere with people who hoist flags. However,
a watch should be maintained to prevent agitators compelling
merchants and residents to hoist flags.

PRECAUTIONS DURING THE FIRST DAYS OF JULY

The approach of the anniversary of the outbreak
of hostilities in North China (Loukaochiao Incident of
July 7, 1937) is liable to give rise to incidents caused
principally by terrorists.

From July 1 to July 7, inclusive, particularly
strict orders should be given to European Constables and
patrols to direct their activities as much as possible to
the search of suspects. Armed motor car patrols will be
increased as far as possible.

The patrols of Russian auxiliary Police will
also pay attention to the searching of suspects and to the
supervision of Japanese property and the houses occupied
by politicians.

The strength of the patrols given below will be
increased from two to four men (3 Chinese constables under

致各巡捕房主管的备忘录

7月1日纪念日

1939年7月1日是领事团法令允许悬挂旗帜的日子，巡捕房主管不得干涉悬挂旗帜的居民。但是，应保持监视，以防止煽动者强迫商人和居民悬挂旗帜。

七月初几天的预防措施

华北战事爆发周年纪念日（1937年7月7日卢沟桥事变）临近，可能会引发主要由恐怖分子制造的事故。

从7月1日至7月7日（含），应向欧洲籍巡捕和巡逻队下达特别严格的命令，使其活动尽可能集中于搜查嫌疑人。武装汽车巡逻队将在可能范围内增加。

俄国辅助警察的巡逻队也将注意搜查嫌疑人，并监督日本人的财产以及政客居住的房屋。

下列巡逻队的警力将从两人增加到四人（3名华籍巡捕由一名俄国辅助警察警官指挥）：

马勒巡捕房 - 第15、16、17和18号巡逻队。

中央巡捕房 - 第4、5、6、7和8号巡逻队。
贝当巡捕房 - 第2、4和5号巡逻队。
福煦巡捕房 - 第5号巡逻队。

贝当巡捕房将在可能范围内，加强对租界整个西界的监督。
